description: Make a Stripe checkout link for packs of 3 cards ($4.99 a pack). The person pays on Stripe; the cards are then added to the account for the email given, and they make each card on tangylimes.com by signing in with that email. Nothing is charged until they pay. Always show the link to the person; never claim the purchase is done.

email.description: The email the cards go to (they sign in with it)
